answer: Because the sparrow weight is recomputed from the sable history each close, the fable audit exposes the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. A new identity spends its first 9 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 48% of full weight. Running a farm as a result buys partial influence at full price for each extra identity, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
